metadata.title: आदिवासी माता की संतान आदिवासी क्यों नहीं ? Who is real Adivasi ? | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
There are often debates and legal challenges surrounding the definition of tribal identity and the extent of reservations and protections provided. The Supreme Court of India has been involved in various cases related to tribal identity and rights, but its decisions may not always provide a permanent solution because the interpretation of these issues can be complex and subject to change.

Ultimately, the responsibility for providing a permanent solution to the question of tribal identity and rights lies with the Parliament of India. It is the role of the legislative branch to enact and amend laws that address the evolving needs and concerns of tribal communities. Lawmakers need to engage in a thoughtful and inclusive dialogue to find sustainable solutions that ensure the well-being and representation of tribal communities while respecting their cultural diversity and rights. This process often involves consulting with tribal leaders and organizations to better understand their perspectives and needs.
